contract.title: TWIN-44 MC固件USART2 921600升级与USART1非阻塞[MC-DBG]结构化日志输出
contract.accepted_scope: Bounded software and C unit-test verification in Docker QA sandbox (gcc) of MC USART2 921600 reconfiguration, USART1 2048B non-blocking [MC-DBG] ring logger, honest MiniMC V2 command dispatch (preserving NACK 0x04 for unimplemented opcodes), real-time state synchronization, send failure handling, and post-error recovery. Physical MCU board flashing and hardware HIL are excluded from this software task scope.

dependency_conditions.required: 继承TWIN-24 MC侧minimc_proto全功能指令处理与级联转发基线

contract.checkpoint: 开工前绑定；固件编译与静态规范自检；独立沙箱与QA审查；收件

commands.command: gcc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -no-pie -fno-pie -DAT32F435VGT7 -DUSE_STDPERIPH_DRIVER -I project/inc -I project/delay -I project/marlin -I project/marlin/marlin_core -I project/marlin/marlin_module -I libraries/drivers/inc -I libraries/cmsis/cm4/core_support -I libraries/cmsis/cm4/device_support project/src/minimc_proto.c project/src/test_twin44_mc_debug.c -o /tmp/test_twin44 && /tmp/test_twin44 && rm -f /tmp/test_twin44
commands.expected: 容器/宿主gcc编译minimc_proto.c与test_twin44_mc_debug.c 0错误，全部正例（USART2 921600初始化、保持真实MiniMC命令集与未知命令NACK 0x04、五类业务实时状态同步、send成功发射STATE+TX ACK）与反例及恢复（2048B环形缓冲满丢包与排空恢复、>192B截断、CRC错误与恢复、TH级联超时与恢复、minimc_proto_send失败抑制伪ACK并恢复）单测PASS

positive_cases: （软件沙箱与C单元测试验收范围，物理MCU实机烧录与硬件HIL不在本卡范围内）minimc_proto_init将USART2(PA2/PA3，AP↔MC业务链路)波特率重配置为AP_USART_BAUDRATE(921600U)，保持USART6(PA4/PA5，MC↔TH级联921600)与USART1(PA9/PA10，MC Debug 115200)不变
在minimc_proto.c中自包含实现USART1 2048B静态环形缓冲+mc_debug_poll_drain非阻塞排空（保持main.c零改动），具备drop_count与trunc_count统计
严格保持minimc_proto.c既有真实命令响应（0x01/0x03/0x14/0x16/0x18及TH级联转发，不伪造未实现命令的假ACK），通过运行态全局变量同步与非侵入式mc_debug_notify_*接口输出[MC-DBG]五类业务字段
所有minimc_proto_send与forward_uart_send_raw调用均严格检查返回值，仅在底层发送成功时输出STATE与TX status=ACK|NACK
negative_cases: 当Debug环形缓冲满时，mc_debug_write立即丢弃当前日志并递增drop_count，绝不阻塞USART2/USART6业务收发；调用mc_debug_poll_drain排空后再次写入新日志立即恢复正常输出
收到未知/未实现命令码（返回NACK 0x04）、CRC错误帧或TH级联超时时，输出对应[MC-DBG] dir=ERR/NACK/TIMEOUT日志，且紧随其后的正常查询与TH级联转发立即恢复成功
当minimc_proto_send或forward_uart_send_raw底层发送超时/失败时，严禁输出伪阳性TX status=ACK，必须输出[MC-DBG] dir=ERR status=TX_ERR err_code=0x06；当usart2_tx_busy恢复为0后再次发送立即恢复正常ACK输出
